facts.fact: KRAY 提前九十分钟到达国家档案馆，门外五月节游客排成的队伍绕了整整一个街区。
facts.anchor: KRAY arrived at the National Archives ninety minutes early.

facts.fact: 正午十二点整，KRAY 走到存放《独立宣言》的展柜前，BUTTONFLY 随即出现在他身旁。
facts.anchor: At 12:00 noon on the dot, KRAY stepped up to the display case holding the Declaration.

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 承认是自己让 KRAY 被解雇的。
facts.anchor: I mean I got you fired.

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 说有一笔二十万美元的签约奖金。
facts.anchor: There’s a two hundred thousand dollar signing bonus.

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 解下自己的手表递给 KRAY，作为干得漂亮的奖励。
facts.anchor: He unfastened his wristwatch and held it out to KRAY.

facts.fact: 新据点的起步地点是西弗吉尼亚 Greenbrier Resort 地下的 Project Greek Island。
facts.anchor: Ever heard of something called Project Greek Island?

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 告诉 KRAY，展柜里的《独立宣言》只是复制品，原件被 Senator Robert Byrd 运到 Morgantown。
facts.anchor: you know it’s only a copy, right?

facts.fact: 两人在 Willard Hotel 午餐谈了三小时，随后开始行动。
facts.anchor: KRAY and BUTTONFLY spent three solid hours there
